definitions.ask: How long should the clobber warning stay on screen before it disappears on its own?
definitions.why: the message is long, and 8000 ms is this plugin's existing duration for long notices

choices.label: 8 seconds, the same as the plugin's other long notice (file rename), so the long message can be read
5 seconds; gone sooner, but the ~170-character message may vanish before it is read

definitions.ask: Should the plugin also hide repeats of the same warning for one target/source pair for 60 seconds?
definitions.why: after the fix, every warning signals real risk, so each one should be seen

choices.label: Every warning shows; after the landing fix, only a real clobber signature warns
Each pair warns at most once a minute; a repeat clobber in that minute relies on vault-sync
